fullDescription: A professional financial and insurance management dashboard featuring a clean SaaS aesthetic, subtle glassmorphism, and a robust tabbed form system. Optimized for fintech, enterprise resource planning (ERP), and insurance policy tracking. Key features include a minimalist light-mode color palette (#f5f8fc bg, #2563eb primary), high-contrast typography (Inter/PingFang SC), rounded UI elements (10px corners), and clear status indicators with distinct color-coding for policy health (Orange, Green, Blue). The layout utilizes a structured bento-grid approach for metrics and a centered modal for complex data entry.

structured.summary: A sophisticated, clean insurance management interface designed for clarity and high-density information handling. It utilizes a soft blue-tinted background with white surface cards, bold semantic headers, and interactive tabbed modals for policy editing.

style.description: The style is defined by its clean, medical-grade clarity using a blue-centric professional palette. Typography relies on Inter for Western characters and PingFang SC for Chinese, prioritizing high legibility with varied weights (Semi-bold to Extra-bold). The UI uses subtle shadows (0 16px 36px rgba(15,23,42,.055)) and light borders (#d9e4f2) to separate content without visual clutter. Interactive elements use smooth hover states and primary blue highlights.
style.prompt: Create a design system using a light-mode color palette: Background: #f5f8fc; Surface: #ffffff; Surface-Soft: #f7f9fd; Primary: #2563eb; Primary-Strong: #2f6df6; Primary-Soft: #eaf2ff; Text-Strong: #111827; Text-Muted: #6b7280; Border-Main: #d9e4f2; Border-Subtle: #edf1f7. Typography: Use 'Inter' or 'system-ui' for body text (14px, #111827), Headers should be bold (16px to 20px), and secondary info should be 12px (#6b7280). Component borders: 1px solid #d9e4f2 with 10px border-radius. Shadows: apply a soft panel shadow `0 16px 36px rgba(15,23,42,.055)`. Input styles: 40px minimum height, 8px border-radius, #dfe6f1 border, focus color #2563eb.

layout_and_structure.description: A two-column layout featuring a fixed-width sidebar (240px) and a flexible main content area. The main area is divided into a header, data summaries, and grid-based policy cards. Forms are contained within a large centered modal with a sticky header and footer.

prompts.prompt: Design a header with a white surface, 1px #d9e4f2 border, and 10px radius. Left side: Title (20px semi-bold) and subtitle (12px muted). Right side: Button group with 'History' (border only) and 'Add New' (solid #2f6df6 background, bold white text) buttons.

A grid-based summary table. First column for row labels (Bold 14px). Cells should contain status blocks: 62px height, 8px radius. Colors: Orange (#ffedd5 bg, #c2410c text) for 'Expiring', Green (#f0fdf4 bg, #15803d text) for 'Active', Blue (#eff6ff bg, #1d4ed8 text) for 'Pending', and Grey (#f7f9fd bg, #6b7280 text) for 'Unconfigured'.

Two-column grid of policy cards. Each card: 16px padding, 10px border, white surface. Top: Policy name (15px bold) and tag (Blue primary-soft bg, blue text). Middle: Progress indicators using 1.5px tall horizontal lines in #dc2626 (danger) or #2563eb (primary). Bottom: Border-top with key-value pairs in 12px muted text.

Centered modal, 800px wide. Header: Sticky, with a 2-tab switcher (Toggle style: background-grey #f7f9fd, active tab-white #ffffff with shadow). Body: Scrollable area with content divided into 'sections' (White cards inside a grey-blue #f7f9fd background). Footer: Sticky, containing context-sensitive note text on the left and primary action buttons (Cancel, Save) on the right.

special_ui_components.description: A high-density grid showing insurance coverage status per family member.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a table where cells act as visual status indicators. Use `display: grid; place-content: center;` for labels within cells. Cells must have a minimum height of 62px and clear semantic color differentiation (Success-Green, Warning-Orange, Info-Blue) to indicate insurance status at a glance.

special_ui_components.description: A selection interface using pill-shaped buttons instead of checkboxes.
special_ui_components.prompt: Design a horizontal flex-wrap container for category selection. Standard state: #ffffff bg, #dfe6f1 border, #6b7280 text. Active state: #eaf2ff bg, #2563eb border, #2563eb bold text. For 'Object' selection, include a 20px circular avatar with the person's first initial inside the tag.
